metadata.title: LOR. — Live Open Rooms
metadata.description: Open-source video meetings that remember. No account, no time limit, no download.

offline.title: No connection
offline.body: This page needs the network. Once you are back online, open your meeting link again.

home.tagline: Open-source video meetings that remember. No account, no time limit, no download.
home.codeSwitchExample: And it understands you when you say «عملت الـ <term>deploy</term> على الـ <term>server</term>».

launcher.joinLabel: Or join one you were sent

errors.badCode: That code is not right. Check it, or paste the whole link.
errors.createFailed: The meeting could not be created. Try again.
errors.tooMany: That is a lot of meetings in a short time. Wait a little and try again.
errors.offline: No connection. Check your network and try again.

room.shareToInvite: Send this link to anyone you want in the room.
room.checkBeforeJoining: See and hear yourself before anyone else does.

errors.locked: This room is locked. The host has stopped letting people in.
errors.notFound: That room does not exist. Check the link.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a little and try again.
errors.joinFailed: You could not be let in. Try again.
errors.offline: No connection. Check your network and try again.
errors.removed: You were removed from this meeting and cannot rejoin it.

room.qrLabel: QR code for this meeting's link
room.qrHint: Or point a phone camera at this.

waiting.title: Waiting to be let in
waiting.body: The host has been asked to let <n>{name}</n> in. This screen moves on by itself.

hostGone.title: Nobody is in the room yet
hostGone.body: There is no host here to let <n>{name}</n> in. You can wait, or come back when the meeting starts.

denied.title: You were not let in
denied.body: The host did not let <n>{name}</n> into this meeting.

denied.title: Permission denied
denied.fix: {browser} is blocking camera and microphone access. Open the site permissions for this page, allow both, then press Try again.

notFound.title: No device found
notFound.fix: No camera or microphone is connected. Plug one in and try again — you can also join with audio only, or just listen.

inUse.title: Device is busy
inUse.fix: Another application is holding the camera or microphone — usually another video call. Close it, then try again.

insecureContext.title: Connection is not secure
insecureContext.fix: Browsers only grant camera and microphone access over HTTPS. Open this page on https:// or on localhost.

unsupported.title: Browser not supported
unsupported.fix: This browser cannot do video calls. Try a current version of Chrome, Firefox, or Safari.

unknown.title: Could not open your devices
unknown.fix: Something unexpected went wrong opening the camera or microphone. Try again, and reload the page if it keeps happening.

call.aloneInRoom: You are the only one here. Send the link to someone.

quality.reduced: Your connection got weak, so video was turned down to keep the audio going.

call.waitingToPublish: Waiting for the host to let you in before you can turn anything on.

chat.title: Chat
chat.noHistory: Chat lasts as long as the call does. Anything sent before you joined is not here, and nothing said here is kept afterwards.
chat.sendFailed: That message did not send. Check your connection and try again.

hands.waiting: {count, plural, one {# hand up} other {# hands up}}

door.title: Waiting room
door.denyIsFinal: Turning somebody away is final for this meeting. They cannot ask again.
door.toggleHint: With this off, anyone with the link joins straight away.
door.off: The door is open — anyone with the link joins straight away.
door.lockHint: Nobody new gets in at all, not even to wait.
door.lockedNote: The room is locked. Nobody new can get as far as waiting.

announce.muteAll: The host muted everyone. You can unmute yourself.
announce.remove: The host removed <n>{name}</n> from the meeting.
announce.lock: The host locked the room. Nobody new can join.

captions.noticeOn: Captions are on. What you say is transcribed and sent to a transcription service.
captions.noticeNotYou: Captions are on. Your microphone is not being transcribed.

error.no_key: No transcription key is set up on this server.
error.rate_limited: Too much at once — captions will catch up shortly.
error.failed: Captions could not reach the transcription service.
error.quota: Today's free transcription is used up. Captions stop here; the meeting does not. Add your own key to carry on.

captions.runningLow: About {minutes} min of free transcription left today.
